name: 2ic-heartbeat
monitorCommand: cd /home/bmazzarol/work/bmazzarol-bunnings && gh pr list --json number,state,reviewDecision 2>/dev/null; for f in state/floor/worker-*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"; done; for f in state/inflight/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cat "$f"; done; tmux list-panes -t work -F '#{window_index}.#{pane_index} #{pane_current_command}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'floor-down'
tickPrompt: [HEARTBEAT] Run the supervise skill tick. Check all workers on the floor, reconcile state files, and report any changes. If nothing changed since last tick, reply [SILENT].

name: laptop-health
tickPrompt: [LAPTOP-HEALTH] Run the laptop-watch skill health check. Report disk, memory, and load. If all healthy, reply [SILENT].

name: laptop-maintenance
tickPrompt: [LAPTOP-MAINTENANCE] Run the laptop-watch skill daily maintenance: check for OS updates, clean temp files, verify disk health. Report findings.
